policy: This registry separates traditional lineage claims from edge-level source verification. An edge is not source_verified until a named chart/record and exact locator have been reviewed. The public graph must display the recorded status rather than imply settled historical fact. exact_locator_verified means the traditional claim is attested at reviewed lb anchors in the named witness; it does not establish historical fact or verify every profile assertion.
